arm_groups.label: HRS-1301 and Midazolam or Atorvastatin Group

brief_summary: This phase I study in healthy participants aims to assess the pharmacokinetics of midazolam and atorvastatin when administered alone and in combination with HRS-1301, and to assess the safety of HRS-1301 when administered alone and in combination with midazolam or atorvastatin.
brief_title: A Study to Assess the Effect of HRS-1301 on the Pharmacokinetics of Midazolam and Atorvastatin in Healthy Participants
official_title: An Open-label, Single-arm, Fixed-sequence Phase I Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effect of HRS-1301 Tablets on the Pharmacokinetics of Midazolam and Atorvastatin Calcium Tablets in Healthy Participants
